interpretations: For each invoice number appearing in `Invoice_Line_Items`, average nonmissing `derived_product_cost` values and separately average valid line ratios (`derived_total_cost / product_price`). Find the average of the invoice ratios, keep invoices above it, and return one row with the three averages over kept invoices: average line product cost, invoice ratio, and invoice ratio minus the overall average. Do not round

For each invoice number appearing in `Invoice_Line_Items`, exclude any line missing a value needed for either measure, then calculate both invoice measures from the remaining lines. Keep invoices whose ratio exceeds the average invoice ratio, and return the same three unrounded averages over those invoices
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
        AVG(1.0 * derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS average_invoice_ratio
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    AVG(i.average_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(i.invoice_ratio) AS average_invoice_ratio,
    AVG(i.invoice_ratio - o.average_invoice_ratio) AS average_ratio_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE i.invoice_ratio > o.average_invoice_ratio

WITH invoice_measures AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        SUM(derived_product_cost) AS product_cost,
        SUM(derived_vat_payable) AS vat_payable
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    WHERE derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
      AND derived_vat_payable IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
invoice_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        product_cost,
        vat_payable,
        vat_payable * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_cost, 0) AS invoice_ratio
    FROM invoice_measures
)
SELECT
    AVG(product_cost),
    AVG(vat_payable),
    AVG(invoice_ratio)
FROM invoice_ratios
WHERE invoice_ratio > (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) FROM invoice_ratios)
